facts.fact: Minister Mavetera announced a Zimbabwe Government Cloud and proposed a Data Sovereignty Statutory Instrument requiring all critical government data to be hosted within Zimbabwe's borders.

facts.fact: Deputy ICT Minister Dingumuzi Phuti said the government is mooting expansion of the National Data Centre to at least Tier four, framed as keeping Zimbabwean data processed, stored and protected locally.

ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera said Zimbabwe is upgrading its national cloud infrastructure and will establish a new Tier 4 national data centre with the e-Government Technology Unit, targeted for completion by end 2025.
facts.system: National cloud upgrade and new national data centre

facts.fact: Government digital platforms including email and ministry websites run on the government's national cloud and data centre infrastructure, with the Government Internet Service Provider hosting ministry websites, according to the ICT Minister.
